description: Police track motor vehicle flight incidents, including pursuits and outcomes.

chips.text: Reasons for motor vehicle evasion trends were not broken down in the report.

description: Saskatoon Police used force in 0.17% of 2025 calls.
Use of force incidents decreased 26% from 2024.
Public Safety Unit deployed 110 times with no force.

chips.text: Commissioner Jeffries noted 0.17% use of force counters misconceptions.
Public Safety Unit deployments were included in the report for the first time.
Staff will consider including Public Safety Unit deployments in future reports.

description: Police face challenges tracking PACT team availability.
PACT calls are difficult to track due to subjectivity.
PACT teams primarily respond to mental health crises.

chips.text: Chief McBride offered to analyze dispatch data comparing PACT responses to mental health calls.
Residents experiencing mental health crises rely on PACT team availability.
How to accurately track unmet demand for PACT services remains a challenge.
